feeding_claim.verbatim: They are bred to finish in 21 to 26 months on grass-only diets, resulting in healthy, flavorful meat.

resold_note: The site also offers pork from Rockin D Farms (Ben and Halie Duerksen), a separate business whose grain-fed hogs are raised at Janzen Family Farms and ordered directly from them.
